title: `Core\Path::thisFile` and `thisDir` are folded while compiling to the file that wrote the call, and `thisDir` joins only a relative literal
scope:
Two `Core\Path` members that name the source file containing the call and its folder, how
the checker folds them, and what `thisDir`'s join accepts. How a path literal at a path parameter
resolves is unchanged.
dependsOnText:
[0241](0241.md) (a relative path literal resolves from the file that wrote it, and a
`__DIR__` constant was rejected), [0021](0021.md) (`require` resolves against the requiring file).
validatedBy:
the Stage 5 checks of goal `path-literals-follow-up`: `nvs-types`' tests in
`crates/nvs-types/tests/paths.rs`, `nvs-ir`'s `this_file_and_this_dir_lower_to_a_string_constant`,
and the two `.nvst` cases named under *Verification*.
